prompt: Which query gives the new MRR LedgerLoop booked in each month of 2024, in each subscription's own currency, with one row per month and currency?

options.text:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE) AS month_start, s.currency, SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) AS new_mrr
FROM subscription_events e
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
WHERE e.event_type IN ('new', 'reactivation')
  AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE), s.currency

SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE) AS month_start, s.currency, SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) AS new_mrr
FROM subscription_events e
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
WHERE e.event_type = 'new'
  AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE), s.currency

SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE) AS month_start, s.currency, SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) AS new_mrr
FROM subscription_events e
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
WHERE e.event_type <> 'expansion' AND e.mrr_delta_local > 0
  AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE), s.currency

SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE) AS month_start, SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) AS new_mrr
FROM subscription_events e
WHERE e.event_type = 'new'
  AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE)
